row.evidence: Craft.io lists identity providers only for SSO: 'Single Sign-On (SSO) is available as part of the Craft.io Enterprise plan and is configured during onboarding with the support of the Customer Success team.' No SCIM or user provisioning is documented.
row.notes: None by absence: SCIM, user provisioning and directory sync are not mentioned on the pricing page, in the help centre (sitemap plus searches for scim, saml, okta, provisioning) or in the Public API article. SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, Google, custom SAML) is Enterprise-only and set up by Customer Success. The Enterprise-only Public API covers workspaces, portfolios, work items and feedback, with no user endpoints. Users are invited by email (individually or in bulk) and removed in the Account Manager. Only editors, team leaders and admins use paid seats. Pricing is per editor; Pro is $79/editor/month yearly, Enterprise is custom.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Enterprise adds audit logs, SAML, IP whitelisting and the Public API, which has no user endpoints. An audit-log API is not documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint, SCIM docs or IdP provisioning app found. Identity-provider integrations are listed for SSO only.

user_api.notes: Craft.io has an Enterprise-only Public API (account API key from the Customer Success Manager). It covers workspaces, portfolios, work items and feedback portals only, with no user, group, role or licence endpoints, so it is not a user-management API.

okta.notes: No Craft.io app in the OIN. A search for 'craft' returns other apps only. Craft.io says Okta SSO works through a SAML setup done by its Customer Success team.

entra.notes: No Craft.io tutorial in Microsoft Learn's saas-apps table of contents. Gallery listing not verified.

fallbacks.notes: Account admins invite users by email, individually or in bulk, and remove them from the whole account or from single modules in the Account Manager. JIT creation on SSO sign-in and CSV user import are not documented.
